purpose: Design and qualification register, not runtime JSON, new material schema, code architecture, solver selection or production certification.

official_documentation_sources.title: Ipopt problem assumptions
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: The stated NLP formulation expects twice continuously differentiable objective and constraint functions; a local solver is not a certificate of global thermodynamic stability.

official_documentation_sources.title: Ipopt standard interfaces
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: The standard interface requests function values, gradients/Jacobian and a weighted Lagrangian Hessian unless a quasi-Newton option is used. Its structural nonzero pattern must remain fixed during a solve.

official_documentation_sources.title: Ipopt special features
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Documents derivative checking and limited-memory Hessian approximation. This is not evidence that an arbitrary value-only or nonsmooth external flash satisfies the solver contract.

official_documentation_sources.title: Pyomo external reduced model
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Describes eliminating external variables through inner equations and evaluating reduced residuals and derivatives. It is a formulation reference, not a recommendation to make Pyomo the runtime.

official_documentation_sources.title: Pyomo external grey-box model
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Defines external input/output/equality interfaces and multiplier-weighted second-derivative contributions when supplied.

official_documentation_sources.title: IDAES smooth vapor-liquid formulation
official_documentation_sources.document_track: Moving stable documentation; page identifies v2.13.0
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Uses auxiliary equilibrium temperatures and smoothing in a vapor-liquid formulation. A formulation-specific auxiliary state must remain distinct from an actual material temperature.

official_documentation_sources.title: IDAES translator
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Translation between property descriptions requires application-specific linking constraints; construction of two state blocks does not supply universal physical reconciliation.

official_documentation_sources.title: thermo phase models
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: GibbsExcessLiquid distinguishes equilibrium and caloric conventions. Documentation also identifies an Hvap caloric approximation as inconsistent but commonly used; approximation must not be conflated with exact consistency.

official_documentation_sources.title: thermo phase and flash tutorial
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Warns that incompatible phase-model combinations can produce discontinuities or missing solutions. Flexible assembly is not automatic compatibility certification.

official_documentation_sources.title: thermo flash families
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Pure, single-liquid and multiple-liquid flash families have different intended scope. Existing B3 pinned-source restrictions remain authoritative only for their inspected versions.

official_documentation_sources.title: Clapeyron flash compatibility
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Model family, phase count, specification pair and initializer coverage vary by selected algorithm. An algorithm-internal derivative requirement is not automatically an exposed derivative of its solved output.

official_documentation_sources.title: CoolProp low-level interface
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Reusable backend objects have phase/derivative restrictions. Reference changes do not retroactively affect existing state instances; actual build and session behavior require qualification.

official_documentation_sources.title: Reaktoro equilibrium solver
official_documentation_sources.document_track: Generated official API documentation, not a pinned deployment build
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: The interface distinguishes conditions, restrictions, mutable initial/final state and equilibrium sensitivities. The coherent chemical-system boundary is the candidate integration unit.

official_documentation_sources.title: ThermoPack state/property methods
official_documentation_sources.bounded_finding: Documents selected property and two-phase flash operations. No parity of every native and wrapper surface or general solid/multi-liquid inverse capability is inferred.

integration_rules.title: Qualify a complete directed integration profile
integration_rules.decision: Admit an operation only for its complete material/data/method/physical-policy/realization/solver-mode tuple; compatibility is purpose- and direction-specific.
integration_rules.applicability: A library, algorithm or model is selected, replaced or combined.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Captured IC-20/35/53; observable and amount conventions; phase/chemistry authority; mandatory output and initializer needs; exposed support evidence. Preserve supported, unsupported and unassessed distinctions.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: A catalog label, successful constructor or pairwise compatibility graph is not sufficient. A compatible A-to-B reporting map need not make B-to-A reconstruction valid, nor does A/B and B/C compatibility establish A/B/C coherence.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A direct TP profile is admitted while its same-material PH variant waits for caloric and initializer evidence.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A generic supports-flash flag cannot authorize reactive VLLE PH or an exact Hessian.

integration_rules.title: Preserve a coherent constitutive and phase description
integration_rules.decision: For each phase/equilibrium/caloric assembly, state the selected constitutive relationships and their compatible standard states before treating the assembly as a package.
integration_rules.applicability: A whole package or a combination of phase/property methods is configured.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Vapor fugacity, liquid standard-state/activity or EOS convention, saturation/Henry treatment, reference data, caloric relationships and selected phase problem. Whole-provider internals may remain bundled when attributable.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Matching names or signatures is not compatibility. A phase model that cannot represent the material or required root cannot be repaired by arbitrary data from another package.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A named gamma–phi configuration records its solvent and dilute-solute conventions and the associated thermal model.
integration_rules.negative_witness: An NRTL coefficient vector and unrelated enthalpy/density values do not establish an energy-consistent flash.

integration_rules.title: Bind parameters to equations and ordered roles
integration_rules.decision: Translate parameters only after their formula, ordered subjects, units, temperature dependence, logarithm convention and missing-value meaning are matched.
integration_rules.applicability: Data are imported, fitted, transferred between implementations or supplied to a submodel.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Exact parameter interpretation; original evidence and selected values; conversions of all coefficients and independent variables; explicit missing/zero/omitted/estimated status.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Name equality such as A12, a value matching at one temperature, or automatic symmetrization is not sufficient. Incompatible or unknown formula meaning leaves the data unresolved.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A directed interaction table and its temperature derivatives are reproduced across an explicit formula conversion.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Two tau functions agreeing at 300 K but with different temperature slopes cannot be treated as equivalent caloric models.

integration_rules.title: Map identity, quantity and every tensor axis
integration_rules.decision: Use explicit material/phase/coordinate mappings for every input and output, including derivative axes and parameter subject roles; preserve the distinction between physical accounts and reporting views.
integration_rules.applicability: A provider or process representation differs from the canonical semantic description.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Constituent mapping, normalized composition chart, total/molar/mass/reference-amount interpretation, native phase roles and disjoint partition declaration. Map forward and reverse separately.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Array order, names, aggregate liquids and apparent/true aliases cannot create material. Missing molecular information blocks only conversions that actually need it.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A constituent permutation maps compositions, property vectors and both Jacobian axes while preserving original material totals.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Composition is reordered but the Jacobian, activity parameter matrix or elemental basis remains in the old order.

integration_rules.title: Complete calorics inside the state problem
integration_rules.decision: Every energy/entropy-constrained solve shall use the complete selected caloric function during the solve and in final verification, not add a missing contribution afterward.
integration_rules.applicability: Residual, ideal, excess, formation or empirical caloric pieces are combined.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Declared decomposition or indivisible complete function; consistent reference and amount basis; required H,S,U and derivative dependencies; complete function supplied to inverse equations.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Residual-only PH followed by a post hoc ideal enthalpy addition is not a total-PH solution. Adding a second ideal contribution to a provider total double counts it.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A host inverse using h_total(T)=h_part1(T)+h_part2(T) reaches the original total target.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A partial model solves 50 kJ/kg at 325 K, but the completed model gives 125 kJ/kg at that point; the candidate fails.

integration_rules.title: Permit named engineering approximations without false consistency claims
integration_rules.decision: Allow useful engineering approximations as explicit package/formulation variants, while separating numerical regularity, thermodynamic identity consistency, operating applicability and independent validation.
integration_rules.applicability: Correlation-based calorics, approximate phase coupling, smoothing, reduced materials or fitted replacement functions are selected.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Which equalities/consistency identities the approximation preserves or relinquishes; intended operations; valid evidence domain; the actual function and derivative to be solved; declared acceptance obligations.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Neither exact-potential consistency for every useful model nor silent inconsistency is imposed. An approximation cannot claim identities it does not satisfy or use a different function for derivatives.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A declared approximate caloric mode can support a bounded duty study with its own checks and labels.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Its phase Cp is reported as dh/dT of a different enthalpy function or its approximation label disappears in optimization results.

integration_rules.title: Augment properties without taking state authority
integration_rules.decision: Attach supplemental transport, interfacial or effective-property calculations only to a declared supplied state, preserving protected phase/species quantities and naming any additional closure.
integration_rules.applicability: A separate library supplies viscosity, diffusivity, surface tension, reporting properties or an effective mixture relationship.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Required state values; phase pair or diffusion frame; composition and solvent basis; extra closure data; mandatory-versus-optional demand; state dependence for coupled derivatives.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: The supplement may not reflash or respeciate by default. A pure-solvent correlation cannot silently stand in for arbitrary concentrated solution behavior. Viscosity is not a transfer coefficient.
integration_rules.positive_witness: An approved liquid viscosity method evaluates a captured liquid phase while leaving the flash allocation unchanged.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A viscosity query rewrites aqueous speciation or erases a second liquid; authority checks reject its use.

integration_rules.title: Keep reactive equilibrium, participation and exchanges coherent
integration_rules.decision: Use a coherent chemical-system or explicitly coupled formulation for reacting multiphase calculations; retain strict conversion, kinetic, frozen and equilibrium meanings and account for every authorized exchange exactly once.
integration_rules.applicability: Reaction or speciation is coupled to phase allocation and energy.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Species and conserved basis; thermochemical/activity data; participation restrictions; extent/rate convention; thermal conditions; external exchange permissions and realized transfers; final combined checks.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Fixed-species flash is not chemical equilibrium. Sequential successes are insufficient if the final state violates earlier chemistry. A retry cannot consume material again or optimize an infeasible strict conversion silently.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A mixed kinetic-solid/equilibrated-aqueous profile checks final quantities under its declared restricted chemistry.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A closed request reaches a reservoir target only by undeclared titrant or gas addition.

integration_rules.title: Reconcile energy references and chemical standards separately
integration_rules.decision: Before combining reactive or cross-package energy values, define the reference transformation and corresponding formation/reaction correction; do not assume a bookkeeping energy offset preserves arbitrary chemical-equilibrium conventions.
integration_rules.applicability: Material enthalpy, reaction heat, chemical potentials or standard states cross a boundary.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Known transformation including composition dependence; chemistry basis and reference requirements; which formation terms are already in material H; genuine exchange/work; dimensionless equilibrium conventions.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Unknown transforms cannot be guessed. A constant species offset cancels in nonreactive conserved-component balances but may change reaction-energy differences; arbitrary per-species chemical-potential shifts may change equilibrium.
integration_rules.positive_witness: Equivalent formation-inclusive and correction-based formulations produce the same selected duty after an explicit reference adjustment.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Adding the full reaction heat twice or removing a model discrepancy as if it were reference energy fails the accounting checks.

integration_rules.title: Distinguish heat-only coupling, representation mapping and material transition
integration_rules.decision: Use different boundary contracts for heat exchange, coordinate/reporting mapping and actual material re-description under another property package.
integration_rules.applicability: Flowsheet regions share heat or a material is represented by a different package or slate.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: For heat: within-side coherent differences and process heat balance. For mapping: conserved basis and information loss. For material transition: preserved independent quantities, known reference relation and target-state calculation.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: A wall is not a component translator. An irreversible lumping map has no unique inverse. Incompatible T,P,z and corrected H cannot all be preserved through hidden heat.
integration_rules.positive_witness: Steam and a hydrocarbon circuit exchange duty through separate packages with no cross-wall species map.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A package switch preserves incompatible T and H by fabricating an unrequested heat input.

integration_rules.title: Differentiate the actual observable in the declared coordinates
integration_rules.decision: Derivative evaluation shall refer to the exact function, parameters, references, independent chart and phase/chemical response used for values, with all required chain-rule terms.
integration_rules.applicability: A solver or sensitivity caller requests any first, second or directional derivative.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Value function identity; derivative input/output meaning, held-fixed quantities, amount/chart, temperature-dependent parameter and reference contributions, method and branch.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: A homogeneous derivative is not a derivative through a flash. A derivative from a different engine is not accepted merely because values agree at one point. Automatic differentiation outside an opaque call does not reveal its internals.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A derivative changes appropriately when a normalized composition chart or nonlinear coordinate transform is used.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Use cp with phase allocation frozen as the derivative of total enthalpy after re-equilibration.

integration_rules.title: Qualify reduced solved blocks and their inner error
integration_rules.decision: A condensed external solve used inside a coupled solver must specify branch regularity, total solved-state response and an inner error policy commensurate with outer residual and derivative demands.
integration_rules.applicability: An inner phase/chemistry solve eliminates local unknowns before an outer solver evaluates residuals.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Inner equations or an independently qualified total-response route; fixed active branch or explicit transition treatment; nonsingular local system when implicit differentiation is used; residual evidence and sensitivity-conditioned tolerance.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Small inner step size is not an error bound. Differentiating only outer direct terms misses implicit response. If inner equations are unavailable, qualify full re-solve finite differences or restrict solver mode instead of claiming implicit derivatives.
integration_rules.positive_witness: For y²-u=0 on y>0 and F=y³+u, the derivative includes dy/du and equals 4 at u=4.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Returning the frozen-y derivative 1 for that reduced function is rejected.

integration_rules.title: Match the solver derivative order and structural contract
integration_rules.decision: Supply the exact derivative order, multiplier weighting, dimensions, sparsity and scaling required by the selected solver mode; do not infer structural independence from a numerical zero.
integration_rules.applicability: A problem is passed to a sparse nonlinear equation solver or optimizer.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Solver-mode declaration; Jacobian availability; full Lagrangian-Hessian or an explicit compatible approximation; variable/residual chart and scaling; a stable structural layout during the solve.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: A library using second derivatives internally has not thereby exposed output Hessians. Limited-memory Hessian approximation does not create a missing Jacobian or smooth a phase discontinuity.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A first-derivative-qualified profile uses a solver Hessian approximation explicitly, retaining correct values/Jacobian.
integration_rules.negative_witness: The number or ordering of callback outputs changes when a phase appears mid-solve, or an at-start zero is deleted from required sparsity.

integration_rules.title: Treat phase and branch changes as mathematical events
integration_rules.decision: Choose an explicit branch/phase-transition strategy for the formulation, and keep physical candidates, solver layout, searched scope and verified stability separate.
integration_rules.applicability: A solve spans appearance/disappearance, saturation, coalescence or alternate roots.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Fixed branch/domain for a local callback, a qualified fixed-superset formulation, or explicit outer restructuring/restart; endpoint/quality treatment for saturation; branch-selection and stability evidence.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: A sign change across a discontinuity is not proof of a scalar root. A fixed number of numerical slots is not physical phase count. Smooth local NLP success is not unrestricted stable equilibrium.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A pure-fluid saturation profile resolves a permitted quality/enthalpy specification without pretending TP alone fixes phase amounts.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A two-liquid request is silently reduced to one liquid to preserve an old callback layout.

integration_rules.title: Qualify initialization and restore the target formulation
integration_rules.decision: Record supported initial-region requirements and temporary interventions separately from the original problem; restore original conditions before its acceptance.
integration_rules.applicability: A library or coupled process formulation needs a seed, phase search, envelope, fixed variables or relaxed equations.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Initializer target, compatible seed provenance, permitted interventions, restoration/reconciliation plan, final original-target checks and bounded attempts.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Failure to find a start is not physical infeasibility. A guessed temperature is not an extra unit constraint. A phase policy used for initialization cannot become accepted physics unnoticed.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A two-phase-only initializer is attempted only with compatible seed evidence, and the original equations are checked afterward.
integration_rules.negative_witness: An initialization fixation remains active and overconstrains the supposed original coupled model.

integration_rules.title: Give each unknown and constitutive relation one authority
integration_rules.decision: Explicitly allocate local unknowns and equation responsibilities between host and provider; choose either elimination or exposure of the same local constraints, not independent conflicting enforcement.
integration_rules.applicability: A whole flash or property block is embedded in a unit or global equation system.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Host inputs/unknowns; provider inputs/unknowns; eliminated vs exposed equations; fixed allocation and reaction permissions; unit-owned balances; required local contribution type.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Fixing arbitrary phase fractions while also requesting incompatible unrestricted equilibrium is overconstraint, not interoperability. A full phase solve cannot overwrite separate nonequilibrium bulk states.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A column owns interstage balances while a local contribution supplies phase enthalpies and compatible equilibrium relations.
integration_rules.negative_witness: The provider and host both independently prescribe the same phase split under different targets.

integration_rules.title: Freeze the realized function and distinguish alternative problems
integration_rules.decision: Pin the function definition, fixed data and realization conventions for a captured solve; state and explicitly declared parameter decision coordinates may vary under that definition. Record numerical attempt changes and require a distinct authorized problem for physical replacements.
integration_rules.applicability: Provider selection, fallback, surrogate/tabulation, cache reuse or an upgrade could change evaluated values.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Realization identity, exact method/data bindings, cache dependency key, branch/numerical context and any approximation policy. A deliberately piecewise/composite function needs its own definition and solver qualification.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Do not switch engines by region or by individual property merely to obtain successful callbacks. Rounded cache keys or table interpolation cannot masquerade as exact evaluation and derivatives.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A compatible warm start changes the numerical path without changing the prescribed function.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Function values use one EOS and gradients use another, or failure switches to ideal thermodynamics inside the same accepted objective.

integration_rules.title: Contain the full session sequence and uncertain native failure
integration_rules.decision: Choose a conservative, build-specific session policy covering activation, all input writes, evaluation, derivative/readback and cleanup; revoke publication independently of native termination.
integration_rules.applicability: A backend has mutable contexts, module globals, opaque caches or uncertain failure behavior.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Tested reentrancy or whole-sequence serialization; process isolation when required by fatal-error risk; active-call lifetime; session quarantine/reconstruction rules; nested-callback/reentrancy policy.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Several handles or internal parallelism do not prove independent cross-case safety. A caught exception cannot contain a fatal in-process crash. A cancelled but running session cannot be freed/reused.
integration_rules.positive_witness: An uncertain failed session is retired and the next request reconstructs from recorded data while accepted host state is retained.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Only the activation call is locked, allowing another model activation before the first property readback.

integration_rules.title: Report trial-domain errors without silently changing coordinates
integration_rules.decision: When a solver trial is not evaluable, return a precise recoverable evaluation failure where the host contract supports it; do not clip, renormalize or project inputs without an explicit differentiated formulation.
integration_rules.applicability: Iterative methods propose negative trial amounts, unavailable roots, invalid logarithm arguments or out-of-policy states.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Physical domain vs numerical search bounds; known cause; recoverable callback semantics; any intentional coordinate transform and its derivatives; no mutation of original trial meaning.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: An interior numerical trial need not be accepted material, but unsupported evaluation is not permission to invent values. A hidden projection makes function/Jacobian inconsistent.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A host line search receives an evaluation failure and selects a new admissible point.
integration_rules.negative_witness: Negative trial fractions are clipped for function values while derivatives assume the original unconstrained values.

integration_rules.title: Require complete original-problem checks and qualified optional work
integration_rules.decision: Accept only the scope supported by original-target, conservation, authority and declared stability/derivative checks; protect trustworthy primary results from separable optional work.
integration_rules.applicability: A provider returns success, partial values or failure after coupled primary/optional calculation.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Original IC-41 criteria; correctly based residuals and scales; required/conditional output evaluation; actual used methods; independence of check evidence.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Missing mandatory evidence is not pass. A failed shared native call with no trustworthy detached primary output cannot be reclassified as primary success just because the failing property was optional.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A phase split and enthalpy pass while separately requested optional viscosity is unavailable and explicitly labeled.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A small inner iteration step or a convergence flag replaces an original PH target check.

integration_rules.title: Preserve run-local coherence and guarded current publication
integration_rules.decision: Reuse or publish results only under compatible actual input lineage, captured dependencies, completion scope and live run/ancestor authority; logical group adoption must not mix obsolete iterates.
integration_rules.applicability: Results feed a coupled solver, are cached, are received late or are proposed as current.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Exact or conservative dependency capture; run-local input lineage; required unit/flowsheet residuals; current target-slot generation; duplicate-command outcome and coherent publication group.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Matching base package revision alone is insufficient. A fitting or replayed candidate cannot acquire production authority. A rejected group updates no completed-group current binding.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A locally accepted flash feeds another iterate but the unit remains unaccepted until its coupled residuals pass.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A stale same-revision stage or a child of a cancelled run overwrites the current unit result.

integration_rules.title: Archive exact reconstructable meaning and qualify actual dependencies
integration_rules.decision: Retain semantic definitions, construction recipe, selected data and the actual realization manifest separately from runtime state; treat dependency availability and distribution conditions as explicit unresolved prerequisites when not established.
integration_rules.applicability: A package is prepared for use, saved, restored, upgraded or shared.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Exact engine/binding/data artifacts, optional modules and relevant build options; opaque-bundle attribution limits; semantic migration record; no current aliases in historical provenance.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Public wrapper source does not supply an absent or separately required engine/database. Loading old values into new equations is comparison, not reproduction. Saving must not execute hidden fitting.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A missing-provider model remains inspectable while its affected operations and reproduction claims are blocked.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A saved session handle or new-default database is treated as the original model.

integration_rules.title: Keep limited and nonbulk materials useful without invented physics
integration_rules.decision: Qualify operations against the information actually justified by empirical, lumped, surface, distribution and inventory descriptions; numerical gaps remain explicit rather than forcing all materials into a molecular-fluid interface.
integration_rules.applicability: Petroleum, carried solids, mass-only material or P3 extensions enter a flowsheet.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Supported bases/conserved quantities; thermal/transport functions where known; distribution or loading denominator and reduction/transfer rules; account purpose; required extra data for each requested operation.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: No fictitious molecular weight, atoms, vapor pressure, unique distribution inverse or one-second flow conversion. Provider rejection does not close a P2 delivery gap.
integration_rules.positive_witness: A mass-only heater uses an explicit h(T) relation without requiring fugacity or molar flow.
integration_rules.negative_witness: A PVT pseudocomponent route is advertised as complete assay characterization and reactive energy support.

integration_rules.title: Promote evidence only at the tested profile and scenario scope
integration_rules.decision: Separate design admissibility, source/documentation support, executable adapter behavior, contract conformance, physical consistency and independent validation; release claims require evidence for the exact instantiated profile.
integration_rules.applicability: A candidate profile is proposed, checked, tested, reused for a new solver mode or compared across libraries.
integration_rules.qualification_evidence: Witness manifest, exact materials/data/operating points, predeclared numerical and scientific tolerances, independence, process-integration scope and unresolved gaps.
integration_rules.rejection_or_limit: Synthetic algebra, matching method names, a phase-table entry or agreement of shared models/data cannot establish real-fluid accuracy or all downstream units. Preserve P1/P2/P3 commitments.
integration_rules.positive_witness: One executed TP fixture adds only its bounded evidence; derivative/PH/reactive variants remain unassessed.
integration_rules.negative_witness: All scenario rows have candidates, so the whole simulator is labeled validated.

reuse_boundaries.host_owns: Selection, coherent assembly, inverse solving, derivative and acceptance contract where not supplied

reuse_boundaries.host_owns: Interphase/chemical problem, unit constraints and allowed derivative assembly
reuse_boundaries.examples: thermo phase model; qualified Clapeyron, ThermoPack, CoolProp or FeOS property surface

reuse_boundaries.name: Complete nonreactive property package
reuse_boundaries.retained: Compatible phase/caloric/data descriptions plus eligible flashes
reuse_boundaries.host_owns: Material identity, request authority, unit/routing/lifecycle and provider qualification
reuse_boundaries.examples: DWSIM configured package; thermo phase/flash assembly; Clapeyron model plus selected algorithm

reuse_boundaries.examples: Reaktoro coherent system; qualified IDAES chemical formulation

solver_modes.name: Direct solved-state service
solver_modes.unknown_owner: Provider solves requested local state; host unit/process model owns its external balances and any recycle.
solver_modes.contract: Return a complete or explicitly partial candidate for the exact state/chemistry contract; outer host need not request derivatives for plain sequential evaluation.
solver_modes.derivatives: Only those explicitly demanded by an outer algorithm. No automatic optimization-ready claim.
solver_modes.phase_policy: Provider handles permitted search with scope and branch evidence; caller must still qualify phase support and stability.
solver_modes.best_use: Heaters, valves, flash drums, utility states and coherent reactive equilibrium blocks in a sequential or hierarchical flowsheet.
solver_modes.limit: A robust direct solve is not automatically a deterministic smooth callback over all solver trial points.

solver_modes.name: Supplied-phase constitutive callback
solver_modes.unknown_owner: Host fixes/supplies local coordinates; provider may resolve only expressly permitted dependent coordinates such as density/root.
solver_modes.contract: Evaluate h, fugacity/activity, transport or other named quantities at caller-owned state without independent bulk redistribution.
solver_modes.derivatives: Derivatives of these actual local functions in host coordinates; numerical derivatives only when explicitly eligible.
solver_modes.phase_policy: Branch and phase ownership fixed by caller; inactive/incipient evaluations qualified separately.
solver_modes.best_use: Column phase properties, rate-based bulk/interface states, rate-law inputs and host residual construction.
solver_modes.limit: Cannot secretly flash or chemically equilibrate to make an out-of-domain supplied state evaluable.

solver_modes.name: Condensed solved block
solver_modes.unknown_owner: Provider eliminates internal y from g(u,y)=0; host solves remaining process residuals in u.
solver_modes.contract: Return the solved observable and a qualified total response through all eliminated state/phase/chemistry variables.
solver_modes.derivatives: Implicit response when local regularity and needed inner Jacobians exist; otherwise qualified full-resolve perturbation. Hessians need total second response or a compatible outer approximation.
solver_modes.phase_policy: One regular branch per local smooth contract, or explicit event/restart/regularized formulation. Phase transitions are not hidden.
solver_modes.best_use: Embedding expensive flashes or chemical equilibria into a coupled process solve while reusing their native solvers.
solver_modes.limit: Reject frozen-phase partial derivatives as total response; quantify inner residual amplification and repeatability.

solver_modes.name: Exposed local residual block
solver_modes.unknown_owner: Host includes local phase/chemical variables and solves their residuals with unit equations.
solver_modes.contract: Provider supplies local residual evaluations and coordinate/bounds/derivative meaning without independently fixing the same unknowns.
solver_modes.derivatives: Residual Jacobian and, when demanded, multiplier-weighted second derivatives or qualified approximation.
solver_modes.phase_policy: Structural candidate superset or outer rebuild strategy; fixed variable/constraint layout for each solver invocation.
solver_modes.best_use: Strongly coupled stages, reactive separation and formulations for which hiding equilibrium would produce difficult nested solves.
solver_modes.limit: A library exporting only a flash result does not expose residuals by inference; host must implement and validate any missing equations.

solver_modes.name: Explicit equation contribution
solver_modes.unknown_owner: Host compiler/formulation owns declared algebraic variables and constraints; provider contributes physical relationships.
solver_modes.contract: Export supported equations/expressions or equivalent qualified mathematical content with units, references and structural dependencies.
solver_modes.derivatives: Host symbolic/automatic differentiation only through represented expressions and explicit qualified external derivative contracts.
solver_modes.phase_policy: Declared fixed structural phases plus tested phase-presence formulation or outer restructuring; auxiliary equilibrium coordinates remain distinct from actual state.
solver_modes.best_use: Native equation-oriented process compilation, parameter estimation, scaling and sparse solver integration.
solver_modes.limit: No automatic extraction of symbolic equations from arbitrary compiled engines; opaque callbacks remain separately qualified contributions.

composition_assessments.admission_contract: Retain actual component data, cubic/mixing choices, caloric convention and explicit flash/fallback settings; adapt detached results and scoped state context.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not inherit mutable stream authority or alternate-model fail-safe as ordinary success.

composition_assessments.composition: thermo explicit constants/correlations + compatible PR phases + eligible flash
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Freeze constants, correlations, ideal contributions, interactions and reference convention; select the flash family according to phase count.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: A built phase alone does not qualify a complete inverse package or multicomponent solids.

composition_assessments.composition: Clapeyron activity/fluid composite + explicit eligible flash
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Specify activity, gas, saturation/Henry and caloric components; consult exact model/algorithm/specification and initializer eligibility, not a moving default.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not select every generalized inverse or multiphase algorithm merely because the activity model constructs.

composition_assessments.composition: Residual EOS properties + externally completed ideal/caloric model
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Reconcile basis/reference and construct complete H,S,U where required; the inverse solver and derivatives use those full functions; update package identity and tests.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Never append missing ideal heat after a residual-only PH solve or add ideal energy twice.

composition_assessments.composition: Phase allocation from engine A + unrelated enthalpy from engine B
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Define the resulting composite model, standard-state/phase/caloric consistency or deliberate approximation, and solve inverse targets using its actual energy function.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Value matching at one point does not prove identity or authorize call-by-call substitution.

composition_assessments.design_disposition: Admissible only as a declared approximation
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Identify relaxed consistency identities, intended use and original numerical checks; derivatives follow the implemented approximating function.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not require exact potential structure for all use, or falsely claim identities the approximate assembly relinquishes.

composition_assessments.composition: Supplemental liquid transport after a coherent flash/chemical solve
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Evaluate the supplied phase/composition on an eligible correlation with solvent basis, domain and diffusion/interfacial convention; include state dependence when needed by coupled solver.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: No reflash/respeciation or unqualified pure-solvent substitution; transfer coefficients remain equipment closures.

composition_assessments.composition: CoolProp water/steam on one exchanger side; general mixture package on the other
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Use each side’s coherent energy differences, correct phase behavior and the host heat balance; no shared material map across the wall.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not equate absolute enthalpies or move species across the wall to reconcile energy.

composition_assessments.composition: Same material moves between different property packages
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Declare constituent map, reference transformation, preserved independent targets, resulting model discrepancy and target solver.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not simultaneously preserve inconsistent T,P,z,H through hidden heat or call a model switch a unit conversion.

composition_assessments.composition: Detailed material is lumped and subsequently reconstructed
composition_assessments.design_disposition: Forward map conditional; inverse generally nonunique
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Define conservation and information loss; reverse calculation requires retained detail or explicitly new assumptions and its own result lineage.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not invent a unique detailed composition from aggregate mass alone.

composition_assessments.composition: Reaktoro coherent chemical system in a flowsheet block
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Keep species/activity/standard thermodynamics and constraints coherent; map reference amounts to process flows/inventories; qualify energy and actual exposed sensitivities.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not inherit upstream functionality through a narrower adapter or detach species from their energy conventions.

composition_assessments.composition: Independent speciation followed by an unrelated fluid flash
composition_assessments.design_disposition: Blocked as a claim of fully coupled equilibrium
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Permit only a defined approximation or iterative coupled procedure that preserves compatible methods and passes final combined chemistry, phase and energy checks.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Two successful standalone calls do not certify the final coupled material.

composition_assessments.composition: Value-only flash wrapped by automatic differentiation
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Qualify a total-response derivative implementation separately; use original inner equations/sensitivities or full re-solve finite differences where admissible.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: AD on surrounding host arithmetic cannot infer derivatives through an opaque native solve.

composition_assessments.composition: Two different engines supply value and derivative of a nominally same method
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Match equations, parameters, references, density roots, derivative chart/order and active branch over the required domain, or use one coherent realized function.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Do not infer derivative equality from same PR/NRTL name or agreement at a single test point.

composition_assessments.composition: Rate-based unit with independently supplied bulk phases and interface properties
composition_assessments.design_disposition: Admissible formulation contract; full implementation remains open
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Host owns transfer laws, area, boundary conditions and separate local temperatures/compositions; properties and interface equilibrium evaluated only under assigned authority.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: An efficiency-corrected equilibrium-stage model cannot claim full nonequilibrium coverage by label.

composition_assessments.composition: Empirical mass-only solid plus ordinary fluid package
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Carry disjoint amounts and justified calorics; name effective-property/routing rules; reserve chemical potentials and atom balances for information actually supplied.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: No fake molecular weight or vapor pressure to fit the ordinary fluid interface.

composition_assessments.composition: CAPE-OPEN adapter around any listed engine
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Map operation postconditions, material/slate conventions and lifecycle; qualification remains specific to the implemented adapter and installed dependencies.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: Interface compliance does not certify cross-engine thermodynamic equivalence, new reaction-interface support or numerical breadth.

composition_assessments.composition: Temperature-dependent automatic provider switching or tabulation
composition_assessments.design_disposition: New declared composite/surrogate, not transparent fallback
composition_assessments.admission_contract: Specify the actual switching/interpolation function, approximation/error domain, continuity/derivatives and parameter provenance; qualify the chosen solver mode separately.
composition_assessments.forbidden_shortcut: An unnoticed jump or rounded cache returning a derivative from another point cannot enter an exact smooth callback.

candidate_profile_templates.name: Conventional nonreacting hydrocarbon cubic package

candidate_profile_templates.name: Multiple-liquid and vapor–multiple-liquid package

thermo FlashVLN for its supported fluid scope

qualification_gates.name: Instantiate an attributable profile
qualification_gates.requires: Concrete material and use, selected coherent definition, exact realization/data or explicit unresolved dependencies, solver mode and desired scope.
qualification_gates.blocker: An uninstantiated template cannot claim production readiness.

qualification_gates.name: Resolve representation and parameter semantics
qualification_gates.requires: Identity/coordinate/basis maps, parameter formula conversions, justified conserved quantities and input authority.
qualification_gates.blocker: Unknown formula, missing molecular conversion or duplicate accounts blocks affected use.

qualification_gates.name: Qualify physical and caloric composition
qualification_gates.requires: Phase/standard/caloric/chemistry compatibility, intentional approximations, total inverse function, unit/boundary convention.
qualification_gates.blocker: Do not qualify energy from residual-only or incompatible standard-state data.

qualification_gates.name: Qualify the exact exposed operation
qualification_gates.requires: Actual adapter supports required state pair, allowed phases/species, outputs, initialization and build dependencies.
qualification_gates.blocker: Source existence or upstream catalog is not executed adapter support.

qualification_gates.name: Qualify solver-mode mathematics
qualification_gates.requires: Unknown ownership, branch/structure, original constraints, derivative chart/order/scale and inner error requirements.
qualification_gates.blocker: A direct flash is not a smooth or differentiated callback by default.

qualification_gates.name: Demonstrate session and failure containment
qualification_gates.requires: Isolated complete call sequences, cleanup/error recovery, cancellation and deterministic context; actual build-specific tests.
qualification_gates.blocker: Unknown or fatal in-process behavior requires stronger containment or an explicit block.

qualification_gates.name: Demonstrate numerical contract conformance
qualification_gates.requires: Executed positive/negative state and derivative fixtures with original-target/conservation/authority checks; source and exact manifest retained.
qualification_gates.blocker: Structural tables and authored mathematical tests do not pass a native contract.

qualification_gates.name: Demonstrate process-boundary and lifecycle behavior
qualification_gates.requires: Executed unit/coupled tests, translation, routing, immutable input, run-local coherence, save/rebuild and guarded publication.
qualification_gates.blocker: Local phase success cannot certify whole-unit/recycle or coherent current results.

qualification_gates.name: Bound independent physical-validation claims
qualification_gates.requires: Independent reference evidence and predeclared scientific uncertainty/tolerances over a stated material/operation envelope.
qualification_gates.blocker: Shared model/data agreement is not independent validation; absent evidence leaves claim limited.

qualification_gates.name: Approve a specific operational use or retain a gap
qualification_gates.requires: Relevant gate results, deliberate approved approximations and evidence limits, exact available dependencies and active publication authority.
qualification_gates.blocker: No blanket package-wide production/validated claim; requested use determines mandatory gates and evidence.

qualification_experiments.name: Freeze data and reconstruct a package

qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Matched definitions and tolerance-qualified outputs with no hidden estimation; actual artifacts recorded.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Change a database or lose a required backend and verify no silent substitution.

qualification_experiments.name: Caloric completion and inverse consistency
qualification_experiments.question: Does the selected PH/PS function include all intended caloric terms?

qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Original complete target residuals pass; partial route explicitly rejected or labeled limited.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Post hoc ideal addition after residual-only solve must fail.

qualification_experiments.name: Inverse initializer and saturation eligibility
qualification_experiments.question: Which inverse requests can actually be initialized and solved?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Test chosen TP→H/S→inverse cases in homogeneous and two-phase regions, pure saturation with/without quality, and required versus absent seeds.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Initializable/unsupported/underdetermined outcomes differentiated and final physical targets checked.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Scalar root sign change at saturation jump cannot count as solved PH.

qualification_experiments.name: Phase-property callback preservation
qualification_experiments.question: Can properties be evaluated without taking phase/species authority?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Supply deliberately separate bulk phases or an externally owned split; ask for selected phase properties and verify every protected quantity afterward.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Required phase/chemical authority invariants hold; permitted density/root choices recorded.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: A property refresh that equilibrates the bulk or consumes frozen species is rejected.

qualification_experiments.name: Total reduced response versus local derivative
qualification_experiments.question: Does a condensed block return the derivative of its actual solved output?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Away from transitions, compare exposed total sensitivities or an implicit construction against controlled full re-solves in the same chart/branch; retain local phase derivatives separately.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Coordinate-matched derivative agreement within declared inner/outer error budgets, plus conditioning evidence.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Frozen-y partial derivative and an AD wrapper around a value-only black box fail.

qualification_experiments.name: Inner-error and finite-difference budget
qualification_experiments.question: Can inner solve error meet outer residual/derivative demands?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Vary inner tolerances and perturbation scales on fixed branch; measure actual repeated-evaluation noise and effect on host residual/Jacobian.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: A bounded policy with sensitivity and noise evidence; ill-conditioned cases are restricted or escalated.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Shrinking the FD step while maintaining noisy inner solves is not accepted as higher accuracy.

qualification_experiments.name: Hessian, chart and sparse-structure contract
qualification_experiments.question: Is the selected coupled mode compatible with the chosen solver interface?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Check local-to-host coordinate/scaling maps, structural nonzeros, Jacobian and requested weighted Hessian. Exercise a declared first-order plus Hessian-approximation alternative.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: No missing chain-rule terms or changing callback dimensions; mode-specific derivative obligations explicit.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Observed numerical zeros cannot remove potential structural dependencies.

qualification_experiments.name: Phase-transition and branch strategy
qualification_experiments.question: What happens when the active phase structure changes?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Traverse neighboring physical states with the chosen outer restart or fixed-superset/smoothed strategy; compare original physical checks and auxiliary state meaning.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Explicit branch event and layout handling; smoothing/regularization limitations retained.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: A mid-solve reordered or resized phase output violates the solver contract.

qualification_experiments.name: Coupled chemistry, reaction heat and open exchange
qualification_experiments.question: Do final chemistry, phase and energy constraints hold together?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Use pinned balanced chemistry and compatible standard data; compare equivalent reference formulations; exercise closed and explicitly open constraints plus frozen/kinetic subsets.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: All original balances and chemical/phase/thermal criteria pass and exchange amounts appear once.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Infeasible strict extent, undeclared reservoir or sequentially invalidated speciation fails.

qualification_experiments.name: Supplemental transport and effective properties
qualification_experiments.question: Can a separate correlation be added safely and meaningfully?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Use captured phase states and explicit solvent/diffusion/closure conventions; evaluate primary and optional variants with fault injection.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: No phase/species mutation; correct subject/units; state derivatives qualified for coupled modes.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Missing diffusivity cannot be replaced by an arbitrary mass-transfer coefficient or silently pure-water value.

qualification_experiments.name: Heat-only and directed material translation
qualification_experiments.question: Does boundary treatment preserve exactly the intended quantities?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Test independent exchanger references, then actual source-target material cases with documented reference relation and either TP or corrected-PH preservation; test lossy mapping separately.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Heat balance independent of arbitrary consistent side offsets; transformations and model discrepancies separately visible.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Simultaneous inconsistent T,H preservation through hidden heat or unique unlumping from a total fails.

qualification_experiments.name: Sessions, interleaving and native failure
qualification_experiments.question: Is the actual complete provider-call sequence isolated and recoverable?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Alternate differently configured cases, then test only approved concurrent paths; inject errors, uninterruptible calls and cleanup uncertainty under the chosen containment.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: No configuration/buffer contamination; running contexts not reused; recovery/reconstruction evidence build-specific.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Several instance handles are not accepted as a thread-safety proof; fatal crash risk is not handled by catch alone.

qualification_experiments.name: Original inputs, alternative recovery and optional failure
qualification_experiments.question: Are retries truthful and are trustworthy primary results preserved?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Force numeric failure, an attempted phase/model substitute, optional-property failure and a missing mandatory check; track candidate/problem identities.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Same-problem retries retain targets; alternatives need authorization and new physical context; optional work does not falsify primary success.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: A failed native compound call cannot recover imaginary primary data from a stale buffer.

qualification_experiments.name: Process integration, iteration lineage and publication
qualification_experiments.question: Do local candidates form a coherent accepted unit/flowsheet?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Exercise valve, compressor, exchanger and recycle; race edits/cancellation with publication, repeat command delivery, and test old-stage/new-inlet combinations.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Required process residuals and coherent candidate sets; no late/group-partial/replayed overwrite.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Equal package revision with stale iterative inputs cannot pass final unit publication.

qualification_experiments.name: Petroleum, reduced and empirical scope
qualification_experiments.question: Are broad-process material routes actually complete?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Run a pinned assay characterization and thermal fixture, separately a reduced black-oil convention and a mass-only real-correlation heater; retain raw-to-derived lineage.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Justified quantity/energy operations work without fabricated molecular data; all remaining P2 gaps explicit.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: A partial EOS custom-component example cannot certify complete petroleum or empirical unit scope.

qualification_experiments.name: Exact restoration and upgrade comparison
qualification_experiments.question: Can the profile and result meaning be reconstructed without current defaults?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Save/rebuild with frozen data, temporarily missing backend, changed reference, coordinate ordering and changed build; inspect exact vs changed-model records.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: No hidden fitting, replayed transfers or resurrected run permission; manifest differences block exact reproduction claim.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: Restored arrays inserted into changed equations cannot inherit original acceptance.

qualification_experiments.name: Independent coverage review including P3
qualification_experiments.question: What evidence can legitimately be claimed?
qualification_experiments.procedure: Review executed fixture manifests against scenario and solver-mode scope; compare genuinely independent reference data where available; independently review all four P3 conceptual action paths.
qualification_experiments.acceptance_evidence: Bounded separate R/E/V/conformance claims; accepted engineering approximations retain limitations; no new numerical P3 commitment.
qualification_experiments.negative_case: A passing synthetic guard or inherited source catalog cannot promote a real-fluid scenario.
